extensionDescription.message: Live Binance/OKX copy-trader risk analysis from the current lead page.

popupUsageBody.message: Open a Binance or OKX lead-trader detail page. The analysis panel appears automatically and computes risk locally from data visible to your current browser session.

popupCheckMartingale.message: Martingale-like adverse adds and long loss holds

popupCheckMargin.message: Loss-period capital injections and current floating-loss risk

popupCheckPayoff.message: Payoff ratio, expectancy, sample size, and MDD

popupCheckScalping.message: Slippage and copyability risk in high-frequency micro-profit strategies

popupPrivacyBody.message: No collection, upload, storage of cookies, headers, API keys, or account data. There is no backend service.

settingNoCopyExisting.message: Do not copy existing positions; wait for the next new entry.

settingSmallRatio.message: If you still want to test it, use a small fixed-ratio allocation and an account-level stop loss.

settingHighMdd.message: MDD is high; avoid oversizing a single lead trader.

settingDefault.message: Use fixed-ratio copy, avoid copying existing positions, and set an account-level stop loss.

loadingText.message: Fetching current public/session-visible data and analyzing locally. Temporary busy pages are retried until complete.

familyMartingale.message: Martingale: each add against the position is a fixed multiple of the last, so a run of wrong-way moves grows the loss geometrically

familyGrid.message: Grid: fixed-size orders on evenly spaced levels, each closed a level away; a one-way trend keeps adding inventory

familyDcaNoStop.message: Averaging in without stops: adds while losing and almost never takes a loss, so one sustained move can wipe out many small wins

familyDcaWithStop.message: Averaging in with stops: adds while losing but does realise losing positions

familyShortTerm.message: Short-term trading: most positions are held under a day, so copier latency and fees weigh more

familySwing.message: Swing trading: longer holds, so copiers may inherit open-position volatility

evidenceBiggestBet.message: Of lead traders who bet 12x their account or more, about eight in ten later closed the portfolio or fell 30% or more.

cautionPreStartHistory.message: Detected trade history predating the official start date by {0} days — bleed-through from a prior, closed lead portfolio. Behaviour stats (win rate, payoff, holding time) already exclude those rows; all-period ROI and drawdown still include them, so the two are on different calibers.

evidenceLossDeposit.message: Capital injections during loss periods are one of the hardest risks for copiers to reproduce.

evidenceDestructiveMartingale.message: Adverse adds, delayed loss exits, or payoff imbalance appear together; martingale-like tail risk is high.

evidenceFloatingLoss.message: There is a material floating-loss position now; a new copier may inherit risk that was not theirs.

evidenceHugeMdd.message: Historical drawdown is very large. This only fits tiny speculative allocation, if any.

evidenceAggressiveGrowth.message: Copiers have achieved substantial real profits without rescue deposits. Despite high historical drawdown, this demonstrates high aggressive alpha; recommend small allocation with regular profit withdrawals.

evidenceCopierBleed.message: Copiers suffer heavy cumulative losses or severe divergence from lead ROI; high slippage, excessive stop-outs, or toxic execution risk.

cautionSevereDeadLoss.message: Max loss hold was {0}, showing severe stubborn holding habits.

evidenceExtremeDeadLoss.message: History of holding dead losses for over 12 days, extremely vulnerable to liquidation during trends.
